title: No test proves another business cannot see or take back a visitor check-in at a branch
what: A desk can check in a member of another branch of the same business, list today's visitors from other branches, and take a visit back. The server checks that the other branch belongs to the same business, and a test proves another business is refused when it looks up a mobile number or checks someone in. But no test sends another business's key to the visitors list or to taking a visit back, and no test reads the business and look-up tables directly as an app user while they hold rows. Today the checks are correct; a later change could drop one with no test failing.
expected: Every branch call that touches another branch's members has a test that sends a key of an unrelated business and expects a refusal or nothing.
who: gyms with more than one branch
how_often: only if a later change breaks the check
fix_line: Add refusal tests with an unrelated business's key for the visitors list and for taking a visit back

items.reason: 8 branch functions: open to anon and authenticated, but each needs a live session key; add branch, open branch and rename business are owner-only (desk and old owner keys get OWNER_ONLY); list branches, visitor look-up, visitor check-in, visitors list and undo accept owner or desk and reach only branches of the key's own business. Pay calls go to the panel server: connect, disconnect, company sign-in and the two switches are owner-only, saving the UPI ID is owner-only, the rest need the gym's desk key. owner_gym_pack (any staff key) is not on the live server yet (absent from the live grants; 0046 says not applied) and the panel then keeps every feature on. Entry machine gate functions are server-role only; the machine address trusts the serial alone (reused FN-L3-server-hq-gate-workers-01). The move hand-over posts the sign-in in a form to a fixed address and the server rejects odd return paths. Demo mode blocks every /api and gym-server call.

gyms: one read rule (own gym only); security.sql reads it with two gyms present, and 0031 test 3 proves the branch list leaves other gyms out. gym_groups and branch_lookups: row rules on, no rule, all app rights revoked, so apps cannot read them; only the security.sql loop reads them, while empty. gym_staff, gym_sessions, crm_records: row rules on, no rule; crm_records is proven by security.sql with rows; 0031 tests 4 and 7 prove another business is refused for open branch, look-up and check-in. Entry machine tables: server-only, see FN-L3-server-hq-gate-workers-04. Payment tables (pay_requests, pay_connections, switches) live in the panel server's own store with no app access; a test proves another gym's desk cannot claim or list payments, but not the settings (FN-L3-server-panel-worker-03). The definer/acl query was not run (db-security.json not_checked).

gym_groups, branch_lookups and the entry machine tables have no test that reads them with rows present (same cause as FN-L3-server-hq-gate-workers-04). Visitors list and undo have no other-business test (new FN-L3-panel-pay-machines-01). Payment settings have no other-gym test (FN-L3-server-panel-worker-03).
Rule applied: no live cross-gym attempt was made; only code, the catalog file and test files were read.
The one key-pattern hit is a comment naming the server role; the gate key comes from the Worker's settings, never written in code. No key values in the six folders.

Payment company keys the owner pastes go straight to the server, are cleared from the screen after connecting, the box has browser autofill off, and the server keeps them sealed and shows only the last 4 letters. No AI or other paid key in this area.

No sign-in or PIN of its own here. Branch keys kept on the device are tied to the signer's phone and signed out on the server at sign-out; the owner's sign-out of a person covers every branch; opening a branch re-checks the owner after the lock. Session length and PIN limits belong to the sign-in area.

No raw HTML anywhere in the six folders (searched). Branch and business names are trimmed and cut to 60 letters and go to the server as data; member names sent to an entry machine lose tabs and line breaks, so they cannot add machine commands; the move return path refuses other sites.
No file uploads in the panel screens here. Entry machine log uploads are cut at 2 MB and 5000 lines, and the unknown-machine list keeps at most 5000 rows.
Payment request ids are 80 random bits. Branch join codes are shown only to the business's own staff. Member pages open only inside a signed-in panel. No public link is made here.
Code here imports only react, qrcode-generator and repo packages; none has an alert. The vite alerts are for the build and dev server, not the shipped page.
